offering_description.value: Develops, manufactures and sells single-use medical devices used in interventional, diagnostic and therapeutic procedures. Customers are hospitals, physicians and other healthcare providers, plus OEM partners. Products are made in company plants and sold through direct sales forces and distributors.

primary_products.value: angiography and interventional catheters; guidewires and introducers; inflation devices and syringes; embolotherapy and drainage products; biopsy and endoscopy devices

customer_segment.value: B2B: hospitals, interventional physicians, outpatient centers, and OEM customers

end_markets.value: cardiology; radiology; oncology; critical care; endoscopy; peripheral vascular intervention

revenue_model.value: product sales: single-use medical devices and kits sold to hospitals, physicians and OEM customers

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: manufactures devices from purchased materials and components, sold to hospitals, clinicians and OEMs

geography_served.value: global: United States, Europe, Asia-Pacific and other international markets

specialization.value: related lines: cardiology, radiology, oncology and endoscopy device lines sharing hospital customers and channels

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: own sales force selling to hospitals and physicians; distributors / dealers: international distributors in markets without direct presence; partners / resellers: OEM customers incorporating its components into their products
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; distributors / dealers; partners / resellers

regulatory_exposure.value: high: medical devices needing FDA clearance or approval, EU MDR CE marking, and quality system rules
